facts.value: Religions are classified as either universal religions, which seek worldwide acceptance and actively seek new converts, or ethnic religions, which are identified with a particular ethnic group and do not seek converts.
Baháʼí Faith, Buddhism, Christianity, Islam, Jainism
Identified with a particular ethnic group and do not seek converts.
Some reject the distinction between universal and ethnic religions, saying that all religious practices are ethnic because they come from a particular culture.
